Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

blocks.text: The leading newly prioritized issue is **CVE-2026-131914 (Idunno AntiCsrf)**, a critical unsafe deserialization flaw; it is listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-24 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-24. A vendor fix reference is available. **CVE-2026-132165 (Drupal Core)** is another important newly highlighted issue; it is listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-24 (exploitation confirmed by CISA).

blocks.text: **Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Idunno AntiCsrf (CVE-2026-131914); (2) apply the vendor fix for Drupal Core (CVE-2026-132165); (3) isolate or patch exposed Optimizely Web Experimentation (CVE-2026-132224); (4) close previously reported Project MONAI MONAI Label and N-able MailAssure KEV exposure; (5) examine Idunno AntiCsrf hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

**CVE-2026-131914 - Idunno AntiCsrf unsafe deserialization (CVSS 9.3).** Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection. Affected releases (NVD): anticsrf = 0.9.0; anticsrf = 0.9.1. Fixed package release: not mapped in NVD ranges; 1 vendor patch or advisory reference available. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-132165 - Drupal Core remote code execution.** Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: not established (no CVSS vector published yet).

Affected releases (NVD): web experimentation < 2026-11-17. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): web experimentation 2026-11-17. blocks.text: **CVE-2026-134882 - TOTOLINK A7100RU command injection (CVSS 10).** A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK A7100RU 7.4cu.2313_B20191024. This issue affects the function exportOvpn of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component CGI Handler. This manipulation of the argument Username causes os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

CVE-2026-132224 (Optimizely Web Experimentation): listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-24 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-24. No named actor, verified victim count or campaign is established in tracked sources. No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds.

CISA added 3 vulnerabilities to the KEV catalog in the reporting window: Idunno AntiCsrf, Optimizely Web Experimentation and Drupal Core. The federal remediation deadline is **November 27, 2026**. This deadline applies to covered federal agencies under applicable requirements; it is not a universal private-sector mandate.

**Defensive hunting:** for Idunno AntiCsrf (CVE-2026-131914), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Drupal Core (CVE-2026-132165), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for Optimizely Web Experimentation (CVE-2026-132224), review the affected service's logs for unusual requests and changes around the disclosure date; for CVE-2026-129514 (CVE-2026-129514), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host.
